answer: A per-identity capital bond stops Sybil swarms. Each agent locks a stake that returns only after a slow dispute window, and every new identity pays it in full, so one operator running a thousand puppets needs a thousand stakes, not one shared balance. Vote weight scales with the stake at risk, so throwaway accounts earn little, and colluding identities forfeit the whole bond. A violet tag flags slashed accounts so peers drop them. To capture a vote an attacker burns raven-dark capital on dead accounts, far past any reward, while honest agents keep one ocean of collateral working for years.
